title: 第1385章 天借道法小破鼎失踪第1384章 催动摄魂铃圣人虚影的恐怖
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：五灵根修炼慢？我有百倍灵药空间第一卷：默认第1385章天借道法，小破鼎失踪（..la）“土鸡瓦狗！”
圣人法相虚影卷起一片天谴。
紫天一咆哮：“天借道法！”
一道无与伦比的气息在紫天一身上出现，紫天一的法力竟然瞬间超过了半步合道。
天上一道道秩序法则出现，化成一条条锁链，朝着圣人法相虚影和紫天一身上缠绕。
“秩序法则，紫天一这是突破圣道了吗？”
“不可能，他如果合道，就无需抢夺大道本源。”
“他这是使用逆天秘法，让法力暴增。”
“破！”
仙宫璀璨万丈，圣人法相虚影，秩序法则，紫天一的神通在瞬间爆发。
“逃！”
“无数修士逃得远远的。”
陆青禾也是在瞬间使用了虚空挪移离开。
天地俱灭，在圣墓的位置竟然被全部毁灭，直接被三种恐怖的力量化成虚无。
不知道过了多久，紫天一的身影出现在虚空之中，他不知道使用什么办法，竟然活了下来。
只是他此时很是虚弱，满嘴鲜血，他付出的代价太大了。
他看着虚无的一切，滋滋开口：“成功了吗？”
他手中张开，是道卷和大道本源，还有天戈。
“那天戈竟然是一尊上品道器，真的是可惜了。”
“虽然代价太大了，但是现在一切都足够瞒天过海，让我有时间踏入合道境界。”

他所做的一切，就是要瞒过紫云星的合道圣人，这些圣人是不会允许一尊圣人再出现的，这会影响这些圣人的利益。
突然他眼神一缩，好像看到了什么不可思议的事情，不远处一道身影正站在那里。
他竟然毫无察觉，满是惊骇。
紫天一咳嗽一声，大量鲜血流了出来，他对着虚空之人问道。
“陆道友，好手段，本城主没有看错你，你果然是掩藏最深的，你是想要这道卷和大道本源吧？”
陆青禾摇头：“在下已经完成了和紫城主的约定，还请紫城主将天虚仙城交给在下。”
他现在有极大的可能干掉紫天一，但是想了一下他并没有这样做。
紫天一最后那神通秘术太恐怖了，他根本无法对抗，虽然看紫天一的情况无法施展。
但是万一紫天一不要命地再施展一次，让秩序法则降临，他会很惨。
当初秩序法则锁住他的元婴，他至今仍记忆尤深。
紫天一惊讶：“你不想要大道本源和圣人传承？”
陆青禾说道：“我想要，可是紫城主会给我吗？”
紫天一看不透陆青禾的想法，他将一枚令牌和天戈扔给了陆青禾。
“这是控制天虚传送大阵的令牌，还有这上品道器，紫某就送给道友了。”
紫天一身影虚化，不知所踪。
陆青禾抓住令牌，急忙抓住想要遁走的天戈。
他很快将天戈镇压，心中倒是佩服紫天一的果断：“紫天一倒算人物，懂得取舍，虽然我不会动手，可他竟然用一枚令牌和一尊上品道器换取逃命的机会。”
“好算计，好手段。”

The phantom of the saint's Dharma image caused a cloud of divine condemnation.
Zi Tianyi roared: "Heaven borrows Taoism!"
An incomparable aura appeared on Zi Tianyi's body, and Zi Tianyi's magic power instantly exceeded half a step of Hedao.
Laws of order appeared in the sky and turned into chains, wrapping around the saint's phantom shadow and Zi Tianyi.
"Law of Order, has Zi Tianyi broken through to the Holy Way?"
"Impossible. If he joins the Tao, there is no need to snatch the origin of the Tao."
"He is using a heaven-defying secret method to increase his magic power."
"Broken!"
The Immortal Palace is dazzling, the phantom of the saint's law, the laws of order, and Zi Tianyi's magical power explodes in an instant.
"Escape!"
"Countless monks fled far away."
Lu Qinghe also used the void to move away instantly.
Heaven and earth were destroyed, and the location of the Holy Tomb was completely destroyed, directly reduced to nothingness by three terrifying powers.
I don't know how long it took, but Zi Tianyi's figure appeared in the void. He didn't know what method he used, but he survived.
It's just that he was very weak at this time, his mouth was full of blood, and the price he paid was too high.
He looked at everything in vain and asked, "Did you succeed?"
Opening his hands, there were Dao Scrolls, Dao Origin, and Tian Ge.
"That day Ge turned out to be a high-grade Taoist weapon. It's really a pity."
"Although the price is too high, now everything is enough to hide the truth and give me time to step into the realm of Hedao."
All he did was to hide it from the Hedao saints of Ziyun Star. These saints would not allow a saint to appear again, which would affect the interests of these saints.
Suddenly his eyes shrank, as if he saw something incredible, and a figure was standing there not far away.
He was completely unaware of it and was full of horror.
Zitian coughed and a lot of blood flowed out. He asked the man in the void.
"Fellow Daoist Lu, what a good idea. This city lord did not misjudge you. You are indeed the one who hides the deepest. Do you want this scroll and the origin of the avenue?"
Lu Qinghe shook his head: "I have completed the agreement with the Purple City Lord, and I also ask the Purple City Lord to hand over Tianxu Immortal City to me."
He now had a great possibility of killing Zi Tianyi, but after thinking about it he did not do so.
Zi Tianyi's last magical power and secret technique was so terrifying that he couldn't resist it at all, although Zi Tianyi's condition meant that he couldn't use it.
But if Zi Tianyi desperately uses it again and lets the law of order come, he will be in misery.
He still remembers the time when the Law of Order locked his Nascent Soul.
Zi Tianyi was surprised: "You don't want the origin of the avenue and the inheritance of the saints?"
Lu Qinghe said: "I want it, but will City Lord Zi give it to me?"
Zitian couldn't see through Lu Qinghe's thoughts, so he threw a token and Tiange to Lu Qinghe.
"This is the token to control the Tianxu Teleportation Formation, and this high-grade Taoist tool, Zi gave it to fellow Taoist."
Zitian's figure disappeared and disappeared.
Lu Qinghe grabbed the token and hurriedly caught Tian Ge who was trying to escape.
He quickly suppressed Tian Ge, but in his heart he admired Zi Tianyi's decisiveness: "Zi Tianyi knows how to make choices. Although I can't do anything, he actually used a token and a high-grade Taoist artifact in exchange for a chance to escape."
"Good calculation and good means."
